empty_space.where: The bottom 40-50% of the poster is completely blank, particularly under the first and second columns, leaving a massive unused canvas area.

small_visual_text.where: The labels in Figure 1 (e.g., tool names) and the numbers/headers in Table 2 are very small and hard to read from a distance.

dense_text.where: All sections (Introduction, System Architecture, Experiments, Conclusion) consist of long, dense, unbroken paragraphs of text with no visual hierarchy or bullet points.

layout.reason: Nearly half of the canvas (44%) is left completely blank at the bottom of the poster, representing a severe failure to balance and efficiently use the available space.

readability.reason: The poster relies on dense, unbroken paragraphs of text across all sections, and the text inside Figure 1 and Table 2 is quite small and difficult to read from a distance.

fidelity.reason: The poster accurately represents the core aspects of the paper, including the three orchestration paradigms, the evaluation on JaxBench and production workloads, and the 1.58x/2.32x speedup results.

holistic.reason: While the content is faithful to the paper, the poster suffers from major layout and readability issues, most notably leaving nearly half of the canvas completely blank at the bottom and presenting information in dense, hard-to-scan text blocks.
